app.title: Aidlc: Adaptive workflow steering rules for AI coding agents
app.author: pramodbiligiri
app.description: Aidlc is a library for defining adaptive workflow steering rules that guide AI coding agents during development, enabling dynamic task allocation and execution control.
proposed_tests: import aidlc; create a simple rule that prints 'hello'
run the rule in an AI agent mock environment and assert output
measure rule evaluation latency on 100 rules
compare rule execution speed to a naive if/else implementation
